patch_description: Replaces the over-shared all-to-all block with independent per-qubit RY mixers and phase channels. Each phase parameter is reused across two RZ gates, retaining the effective phase freedom of the strongest prior architecture while reducing the circuit parameters from 146 to 98. The commuting nearest-neighbor CZ chain is reordered into even/odd brickwork layers, preserving its unitary exactly while substantially reducing depth. This restores local expressivity, removes redundant phase parameters, and avoids the current circuit’s costly complete-graph entanglement.
